:::{#rem-argmin-vs-minimum}
#### Smallest value versus where it occurs

The smallest value itself is $\min f(A)$,
the minimum (@def-minimum)
of the [image](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-image) of $f$,
and the argmin is where that value is attained.
For example, let $f(x) = x^2$ on $A = \cb{-1, 0, 2}$.
The image is $f(A) = \cb{1, 0, 4}$,
so the smallest value is $\min f(A) = 0$,
and $\argmin_{x \in A} f(x) = \cb{0}$.

The argmin is empty when $f$ has no smallest value,
for example $f(x) = x$ on $(0, 1]$.

:::
